owner: CC (probe + ticket + crossings); Akien (the ruling that made this the starting place: decision 2026-08-07-the-implementation-order, confirmed same day — and the watch's consumer, by the spec below)
intention: ARM /idea's OWN WATCH. The capture door's promise is an address someone later reaches for; its charter names the efficacy signal in how_it_learns ('an idea that never gets reached for at all says something about whether the queue is being worked') and then says 'NOT-YET: nothing reads it'. This ticket compiles that sentence into the reader: a probe at skills/idea/probes/idea_capture_pickup.py that walks CairnCommons/ideas/ against answers.from_idea on /intent's live berths, fires on a standing rot pattern, and clears on demonstrated working of the queue at scale — then carries the boat from its standing red ('exit REFUSED for want of a probe') through WATCHME to PROVED.
why: Law 3 — /idea at PROVEME is a hypothesis about capture, labeled as one by its own journaled red since 2026-08-04. Law 9 gives the distance: the boat is built, proven, sealed, and NOT WATCHED, and red is the resting state until the watch stands. The lived symptom is the store itself: on the day this ticket was cast the queue already held one rotting record (2026-08-06-the-sleep-trigger-captured-across-three-turns, uncited by any birth) — the probe's first honest survey found real work standing.
traces_to: Law 3 — nothing is known until measured; the queue's working is the measurement
Law 9 — the standing 'exit REFUSED for want of a probe' is the red this closes
Law 1 — the settled existence claim (capture->pickup works, measured live 2026-08-07) is CITED in the spec, not re-watched
decision 2026-08-07-the-implementation-order — tier 2, the ruled starting place
state: skill@v2: THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> WATCHME(idea-capture-pickup) -> [PROVED]
gates: skill@v2's registered set: build gate at the PROVEME forward crossing (build_inspector's sieves over skills/idea itself); emission gate at the WATCHME forward crossing (cairn/tools/base/watchme_spec.py — spec complete, probe berthed and armed); exit gate at the PROVED entry (proved_answers_the_chart, clean by absence unless a chart claims this ticket); proof gate: skills/idea/proofs/test_idea_door.py (26 teeth), green twice and sealed netns 2026-08-04.

watchme.trigger: every pulse reaching the skill's shim — the probe globs CairnCommons/ideas/ against answers.from_idea on /intent's live berths (files only: no device, no bus, no network) and fires when >= 12 captures stand uncited. Rot is the pattern it fires on, not absence of pickups: a queue where twelve rot while three get picked is still rotting, and the three would mask a picked==0 clause.
watchme.enough: cleared once working the queue is demonstrated AT SCALE: >= 12 captures picked up through the door AND fewer than 12 standing. A POPULATION claim on purpose — the existence claim ('capture -> pickup works end-to-end') was measured live 2026-08-07, when capture 2026-08-07-yes-we-need-to-build-out-idea was cited by two /intent births within the hour, and a watch standing on a settled question is the re-derivation Law 1 refuses. Trigger and clear are mutually exclusive by construction, so the roster's recorded clear-before-fire bug cannot be rebuilt here by drift. Akien may also retire the watch by ruling.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against THIS ticket's falsifier — captured/picked/unpicked counts plus the rotting ids BY NAME, so the poke is complete on the first pass and the owner never re-runs the survey to learn which twelve
watchme.nexus: hypothesize — the claim is a prediction about how the queue behaves once capture is frictionless, and a prediction that did not hold belongs in the tree that remembers what killed which
watchme.consumer: Akien, through the owner's gate. The probe deposits and pokes; the rot pattern's two readings (the queue is not being worked, or ideas are consumed off-door) are his fork to call, and any back-edge on /idea's charter is his act (Law 6).

falsifier: RED on any of: the probe cannot tell picked from unpicked off the real stores (measured green at cast: the one rotting record it names is real); the watch can clear before it can fire (structurally excluded — fire needs unpicked >= 12, clear needs unpicked < 12); the emission gate refuses the crossing; or the boat still stands short of PROVED when this ticket claims done.
horizon: Re-read when: the beat becomes a real number (re-tune the probe's 1000-pulse _HORIZON — the roster's shared filed edge); the store's cadence makes the hand-set floor of 12 tunable (learns-its-gates IOU, named at the cast); and at the first fire or clear in anger.
children: none, because the build is one probe file plus this ticket — no decomposition to spawn. The future consumer of the counts (the dial over /intent's questions) is named in the charters and deliberately NOT spawned here: a manager for an empty room.
